blocks.name: Foundation Phase
blocks.goal: Build a runnable base around BJJ

blocks.name: Trail Half Build
blocks.goal: Peacock Gap Trail Run half marathon (Sat Dec 5 2026, San Rafael) -- rung 1 of the race ladder
blocks.adds: weekly vertical targets to 4,000 ft, back-to-back long/easy pairing, gut training to 65 g/hr, strength held at maintenance

meta.entry_assumption: Block 2 starts where Block 1 week 11 leaves you -- 22 mi/wk with a 12 mi long run -- so week 13 steps DOWN to 20.5 mi and a 9 mi long run on purpose, then builds over 11 weeks to a 33 mi peak and a 15 mi long run. The 16-19 mi reload weeks of the original draft were written for someone arriving at 16 mi/wk and are not used. If you finish Block 1 short of 20 mi/wk or a 10 mi long run, repeat week 13 before advancing and accept a smaller peak.

weeks.label: Week 12 -- Deload + Retest

plan: RETEST 1 of 3 -- MOBILITY. Do these warm, straight after the flow: Sit-and-reach (cm), Ankle dorsiflexion knee-to-wall L and R (cm).
Log both in the Week 12 panel. Week 1 is the number you are beating.
BJJ: technique and drilling only all week. Deload means the mat gets lighter too.
Mon.recovery: Wim Hof 15 min + Stick Mobility (in flow) + RAD balls 5-10 min

plan: RETEST 2 of 3 -- STRENGTH. Do these FIRST, fully fresh, before the run: Push-ups max in 1 min, Goblet squat max reps in 1 min (note DB weight), Farmer carry max distance in 60s (note load), Plank hold max time.
Use the same loads you used in week 1 or the comparison means nothing. If you cannot remember, note what you used this time and that becomes the new baseline.
RUN: Easy 3 mi -- Zone 2, HR under 140. Shakeout after the tests, not a session in itself
No Strength A this week. The tests are the strength work.

plan: RUN: Easy 4 mi -- Zone 2, HR under 140. Flat and relaxed; no quality this week

plan: Strength B -- Upper / Pull (DELOAD: 2 sets not 3, same weights)

plan: RETEST 3 of 3 -- THE MILE. Warm up 1.5 mi easy, then 1 mile as hard as you can hold, then 2.5 mi easy to cool down. 5 mi total.
Run it on flat ground you can repeat -- track, bike path, anything measured. Same course every retest or the number drifts.
Pull the last two numbers off Apple Health and log them: Resting heart rate (morning average) and Average sleep across the past 7 nights.
Fill in the rest of the Week 12 panel and compare every line to week 1. This is the whole point of the week.
Block 2 starts tomorrow. Twelve weeks to Peacock Gap, and Monday becomes a running day.
